annotations.text:
MAIN — dense / energetic.
Navy ground from the existing poster, dot grid, colour-coded activity chips using the site accent palette. Leads with the TICKETS ARE LIVE sticker. Everything a first-time reader needs in one pass.

ALT — bold / minimal.
Ink ground, headline-led, no chips. Reads across a room and holds up when Instagram shrinks it in-feed. Fewer facts, more impact — the activity list drops to one quiet line.
